extensionDescription.message: Control one explicitly selected YouTube video from your paired iPhone.

description.message: Start connections and enable YouTube on your Mac, then select the video tab.

privacy.message: Only the selected YouTube video is shared. No browsing history or account data.

selectHint.message: Open a YouTube watch page and select it here.

setupHint.message: Enable YouTube in the Mac Agent. Install the native host and reconnect here.

selectError.message: Open a YouTube watch page, reload it after installing the extension, and try again.
